remarks: A Half-Acre of Ojai Magic Where Possibility Grows on TreesTucked into one of Ojai's most sought-after pockets, this half-acre sits right in the middle of it all just moments from the heart of town, with shops, dining, and everything Ojai is loved for close at hand. Step onto the land and you're greeted by nine flourishing Spanish olive trees, a gorgeous heritage oak standing sentinel, and rich, fertile soil excellent for planting. An award-winning, green-living 359 sq. ft. tiny home lovingly crafted from reclaimed wood and steel out of Texas set on a solid foundation.
